title: Trump describes himself as 'Acting President of Venezuela' in Truth Social post
description: NEW YORK, Jan 12:  US President Donald Trump has posted a photo of himself on his social media site Truth Social with his designation listed as “Acting President of Venezuela.” The post on Truth Social on Sunday has Trump’s official portrait and then the designation “Acting President of Venezuela, “Incumbent January 2026.” It also has his designation as the 45th and 47th President of the United States, who assumed office on January 20, 2025. title: Colombian rebels call for a 'national accord' after the US intervention in Venezuela
description: Colombia’s National Liberation Army called for a “national accord” to overcome political conflicts, as it faces the prospects of attacks from the governments of Colombia and the United States.

title: Analysis: Trump is pledging to ‘rescue’ protesters in Iran
description: President Donald Trump billed strikes on Venezuela earlier this month as being about drugs, gangs invading the United States and law enforcement – i.e. arresting indicted leader Nicolás Maduro. But of late, he seems conspicuously preoccupied with the country’s oil wealth.

title: The Rise of Smash-and-Grab Diplomacy in a World of Resource Scarcity
description: The United States’ overt seizure of resources in Venezuela signals a broader shift toward “smash-and-grab” diplomacy that may define international relations in an era of growing global scarcity.

title: Why is Cuba strategic for the United States? Expert explains amid Venezuela crisis
description: From why Cuba is in Trump's crosshairs to the island nation's strategic importance, here's all you need to know about the United States' interest in the country amid the recent threats after a ‘large-scale’ attack on Venezuela.

title: Trump Tells Cuba to Make a Deal After Severing Its Oil Lifeline
description: The United States has cut off Venezuela’s oil and financial support to Cuba, sharply escalating economic pressure on the island as President Trump urges Havana to strike a deal or face collapse.

title: Russia’s fearsome arsenal fizzled in Venezuela. Here’s why.
description: The vaunted, Russian-made S-300 and Buk-M2 air defense systems were supposed to be a potent symbol of the close ties between Venezuela and Russia, two rivals of the United States.

title: Trump calls himself Venezuela's acting president in Truth Social post
description: Trump has repeatedly asserted that the United States will "run" Venezuela, despite its interim President Delcy Rodríguez insisting that no foreign power was governing her country.

title: Oil Prices Remain Stable Near $60 Despite Geopolitical Noise
description: Global oil markets have remained relatively steady despite renewed geopolitical tensions between the United States and Venezuela.

title: What if Greenland’s next?
description: Today, we’re exploring Venezuela’s political lineage and a socialist revolution which positioned the country in the crosshairs of the United States.
